name: numpy.polynomial.Polynomial
summary: A polynomial in the power basis (lowest power first), with fit, roots, deriv and integ.
differs: Accepts every argument of NumPy 2.5.1's signature, but not every value: one outside what is tested may be refused (an error, never a different answer).
Checked against NumPy 2.5.1 by its signature and examples, not reviewed line by line.
